defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20. Upgrade notes come from the UPGRADE-*.md files in the shopware/shopware repository.

upgrade.title: Shopware version upgrades
upgrade.description: Shopware upgrades: the 6.6 to 6.7 to 6.8 path, release notes, resolving deprecations, PHP-side migration patterns. Use when upgrading a Shopware plugin to a newer version.
upgrade.intro: What breaks between versions and how to fix it. Start with the deprecation list for your target version.

admin.title: Shopware administration migration
admin.description: Shopware administration migration: sw-* to Meteor mt-* component mapping, Webpack to Vite, Vuex to Pinia. Use when migrating Shopware administration code to 6.7.
admin.intro: The three administration migrations 6.7 forces, each with a mapping table.
